receiver.heading: KUDOS RECIPIENTS: HERO BADGES FOR POSITIVE IMPACT
receiver.intro: Based on the number of teammates who send you Kudos, you'll earn the matching Hero badge, shown right next to your profile name.

newHero.desc: The journey of spreading good has begun – the first thank-yous and recognitions have found their way to you.

risingHero.desc: Your presence is growing in your teammates' hearts through your kindness and dedication.

superHero.desc: You've become a trusted and beloved icon – always ready to help and remembered by many teammates.

legendHero.count: More than 20 people sent you Kudos
legendHero.desc: You've become a legend – leaving an unforgettable mark on the team through your heart and actions.

sender.heading: KUDOS SENDERS: COLLECT ALL 6 ICONS, GET AN INSTANT MYSTERY GIFT
sender.intro: Every Kudos you send is posted on the system and earns ❤️ from the Sunner community. For every 5 ❤️, you open 1 Secret Box for a chance to receive one of SAA's 6 exclusive icons.
sender.note: Sunners who collect all 6 icons will receive a mystery gift from SAA 2025.

national.heading: NATIONAL KUDOS
national.body: The 5 Kudos with the most ❤️ across all of Sun* will officially become National Kudos and receive a special gift from SAA 2025: Root Further.
